description: Demolition of dwelling and re-development to provide a detached two storey dwelling (1 x 5 beds ) with habitable roof space; parking; vehicle access; hard and soft landscaping; bin and cycle storage
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Restricted Lighting<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">No external lighting shall be installed on the dwelling hereby permitted
unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of
the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be
designed to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The
lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the
approved details.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style=""><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour plan of
biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification,
and location of enhancements such as bat boxes, bird boxes, and habitat
creation such as native shrub planting and pond creation, shall be submitted to
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the
biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in
accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Drainage and SuDS Details<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:14.6pt;text-align:justify"><u><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">No development shall commence (excluding demolition and site clearance)
until full details of revised sustainable drainage scheme have been submitted
to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:32.6pt;text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">The scheme shall include:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">a) Confirmation that the drainage system shall be fully separated, with
no combined connection permitted. Foul water shall be directed to the public
foul sewer, and surface water shall be directed to an appropriate surface water
system.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">b) Full details of any proposed soakaway, including the area to be
served, volume calculations, infiltration testing results, and construction
specifications.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">c) Detailed design and construction information for permeable paving,
including sections and materials, demonstrating a minimum 250mm sub‑base depth
to provide adequate water storage.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">d) A management and maintenance plan for all drainage features,
including permeable paving, for the lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">The approved scheme shall be implemented in full prior to the first
occupation of the development and thereafter retained and maintained in
accordance with the approved details.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:32.6pt;text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>





















</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Landscaping<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify"><u><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted
shall not be occupied until there has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape
works for the site submitted to, and approved by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less
than 1:100), schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container
sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Hard
landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments (materials, scale
of boundary, location) and details of hard surfacing materials to be used in
the landscaping of the site, Written specification of planting and cultivation
works to be undertaken, A landscape implementation programme with proposed
timing / dates for the works.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:31.55pt;text-align:justify;mso-pagination:
none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Details of Materials<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify"><u><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby
permitted shall not proceed above the damp proof course level until details of
the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:38.2pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-38.2pt;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">(a) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; the replacement dwelling<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:38.2pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-38.2pt;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">(b) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; the ground surfacing<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:38.2pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-38.2pt;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">(c) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; the boundary treatment, including side
gates and fencing railings (if required) have been submitted to, and approved
in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be completed
in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:
none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Sustainability and Energy Strategy<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify"><u><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none">Notwithstanding
the approved plans, the construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby
permitted (other than works of demolition) shall not commence until details of
a sustainability and energy strategy for the development shall be submitted to
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details
shall demonstrate how the development will:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:
none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">(a) minimise operational energy
demand and carbon emissions;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">(b) provide low-carbon heating
and cooling systems with no connection to the gas network;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">(c) maximise the provision of
on-site renewable energy generation where feasible;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">(d) achieve a potable water
consumption rate of no more than 105 litres per person per day through the use
of water-efficient fittings and appliances; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">(e) accord with the requirements
of Policies CN1 and CN2 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="text-align:justify;mso-pagination:
none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none">&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none">The development shall thereafter
be carried out in full accordance with the approved details and retained as
such for the lifetime of the development.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;mso-pagination:none;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none"><br></p>

The windows and doors in the elevation of the proposed development facing towards 30 and 34 Gerard Road shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Levels<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">-No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels
of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land
and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have
been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="text-align: justify;">Fire Safety Statement, Design and Access
Statement, Site Location Plan, 32GERARDRD-001, 32GERARDRD-002, 32GERARDRD-003,
32GERARDRD-004, 32GERARDRD-005, 32GERARDRD-006, 32GERARDRD-007, 32GERARDRD-008,
32GERARDRD-009, 32GERARDRD-010, 32GERARDRD-011, 32GERARDRD-012, 32GERARDRD-013,
32GERARDRD-014, Bike Shed Plan, Landscape Implementation Programme, Wheelie Bin
Store Plan, Flood Risk Assessment</span><br><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;tab-stops:37.1pt"><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Secure by Design<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;tab-stops:49.65pt"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;tab-stops:49.65pt">Evidence of certification of Secure by
Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the Local
Planning Authority in writing for approval in writing before any part of the
development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and
operated in accordance with the approval.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;tab-stops:49.65pt"><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Construction Logistics Plan<o:p></o:p></u></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify"><u><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></u></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">No construction works shall take place, including demolition, until a
Construction Method Statement and Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and
approved in writing by, the local planning authority. It shall provide for: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:1.0cm;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">a) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; detailed timeline for the
phases and implementation of the development <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:1.0cm;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">b) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; the parking of vehicles of
site operatives and visitors; <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:1.0cm;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">c) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; loading and unloading of
plant and materials; <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:1.0cm;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">d) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; storage of plant and
materials used in constructing the development; <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:1.0cm;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">e) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; measures to control the
emission of dust and dirt during construction; and <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:1.0cm;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">f) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; scheme for
recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved
Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as
may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout the
construction period.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><u>Fire Safety Statement</u><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify">Notwithstanding the submitted details and approved plans, the
development hereby permitted shall not progress beyond damp proof course level,
until a Fire Safety Statement is submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the
development will function in terms of the following:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:34.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-34.55pt">a) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; identify suitably
positioned unobstructed outside space: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:62.9pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">i) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; for fire appliances to be
positioned on<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:62.9pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-1.0cm">ii) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; appropriate for use as an
evacuation assembly point<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:34.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-34.55pt">b) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; is designed to
incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of
serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems
and passive and active fire safety measures<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:34.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-34.55pt">c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; is constructed in an
appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:34.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-34.55pt">d) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; provide suitable and
convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building
users<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:34.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-34.55pt">e) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; develop a robust
management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and
published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and
published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:34.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-34.55pt">f) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; provide suitable access
and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the
development. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved
details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:34.55pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify;text-indent:-34.55pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The development shall
be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify"><br></p>
